claims.text: Validation is an automatic check that entered data is reasonable and follows the stated rules; verification is a check that data was copied or transferred accurately; neither of them proves that the data is true.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Data integrity is data being accurate, complete and consistent, and validation and verification protect it by catching unreasonable entries and inaccurate copies at the moment they happen; the checks are reasonable rather than proofs of truth, so they cannot prove the data correct.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A range check tests that a value lies between a lower and an upper limit, and a limit check tests a single stated boundary, at most or at least a stated amount.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A length check tests the number of characters in an entry, and a format check tests the pattern of the entry against a stated layout.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A presence check tests that a field has not been left empty, and an existence check tests that a value appears in the file of permitted values.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A check digit is an extra digit calculated from the other digits of a code and checked when the code is entered, so a mistyped digit usually fails the calculation.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Verification during data entry includes a visual check, where the entered data is shown for the user to check against the source, and double entry, where the data is entered twice and the two entries compared, so a disagreement shows a mistype.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Verification during data transfer includes a parity check, where a bit is added to a byte so the count of 1 bits is even or odd as agreed and a byte arriving with the wrong count is detected, and a checksum, a value calculated from a block and recalculated on arrival, so a mismatch signals corruption.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).
